description: Curated index of external design, content, agent, 3D scene-production and technical illustration repositories.

defaults.nvidia_prompt_policy: Never send third-party Skill files, submodule content, private agents, references or Obsidian notes to NVIDIA. NVIDIA receives only generic role descriptions and public/synthetic task text.
defaults.three_d_policy: No diffusion image generation or paid mesh-generation APIs. Three.js is the default web 3D engine; select Babylon.js, PlayCanvas, OGL, Curtains.js, ThreePipe, R3F/Drei, TresJS, Threlte, model-viewer or Filament by task. Blender/Three.js/GitHub Actions render backends are not operational until installation or connection and end-to-end visual smoke tests succeed. GitHub Actions Blender is a planned CPU fallback; never assume a GPU runner or expose private client assets in public repos.

sources.name: Guizang Social Card Skill
notes: AGPL-3.0: preserve license/notices for distribution and modifications.
HTML+Playwright render flow; use user-authorized or properly licensed image assets.

sources.name: OpenDesign
notes: Large repository; intentionally not downloaded locally.

Local-first desktop workflow, but optional product analytics and conversation/tool-content telemetry are enabled by default unless disabled in Settings → Privacy; a scrubbed safety/reliability channel may remain enabled.
Cloud Go plans advertise paid credits; do not rely on paid/cloud features.
Review PRIVACY.md before running the app.

runtime.full_agent: Managed Deep Agents, LangSmith sandboxes/tracing and optional Slack integrations are not installed or assumed free.

notes: Preserve NOTICE.md and third-party license files; not every nested file inherits Apache-2.0.
Use local Skills selectively; do not deploy the complete Content Studio stack.

sources.name: Huashu Design
notes: MIT applies to source, Skill instructions and scripts; keep original MIT notice.

notes: Do NOT install the PyPI package named agent-reach; it is not this project.
Read-only: no posting, commenting, likes or DMs. Do not import cookies, login or configure channels automatically.
Stop on NEED_LOGIN, RATE_LIMITED or PLATFORM_BLOCKED. User must perform any login.

Potential service/account costs and terms must be checked before use.

Use local brand profiles only with user-approved brand assets.

sources.name: Yingzao · 营造
notes: No LICENSE file was found at the repository root; treat content as all-rights-reserved. Listed for discovery only. Do not copy, vendor, redistribute or load its SKILL.md into prompts until licensing is clarified.

sources.name: TS Digitais 3D Scene Production Guide
notes: Guia de integração first-party da TS Digitais; não é uma ferramenta de renderização.
Não usar geradores por difusão, nem APIs pagas de geração de malha.
Exige motor de render realmente instalado/conectado antes de qualquer afirmação de render executado.
Motor de navegador: consultar a matriz 3D da Skill; Three.js é default, alternativas são escolhidas por caso.
GitHub Actions headless para Blender é somente arquitetura planejada; não habilitar como backend antes do teste E2E.

runtime.execution: arbitrary Python inside Blender; require reviewed scripts and saved project
runtime.telemetry: minimal anonymous metrics by default; DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true disables all telemetry

notes: MCP upstream uses arbitrary Python execution in Blender; use isolated project, save before execution and review scripts.
Keep server bound to localhost; never expose unauthenticated socket publicly.
Premium generation routes (Meshy/Tripo/Hyper3D/Hunyuan/World Labs) are excluded; no API keys.
Poly Haven CC0 content is suitable for free use subject to any bundled third-party conditions.

notes: Somente Skills/documentação selecionadas copiadas; aplicação MCP completa não instalada.
Python 3.13+ indicado no README atual; não instalar no Python 3.12 global.
Não presumir que os números de ferramentas/operações estejam testados no runtime TS Brain.

Licença ISC; manter avisos correspondentes.

Starter demo não foi importado, somente Skill, references e scaffold; npm dependencies não instaladas.

sources.name: Impeccable Design Skill
notes: Skill e referências selecionadas copiadas do upstream; repo integral (~933 MB) não baixado.
Hooks, CLI, scripts, browser live mode e engine binário não instalados nem ativados.
Não executar os comandos impeccable install/live nem hooks sem revisão e consentimento: alguns caminhos do Live podem invocar CLI local com sandbox/approval bypass.
O detector determinístico verifica padrões técnicos/estruturais; não substitui crítica estética humana nem revisão do contexto da marca.
Apache-2.0; preservar licença e avisos.
TS Brain loads a first-party safe adapter at external/design-library/impeccable/SKILL.md; original upstream Skill is preserved as UPSTREAM-SKILL.md and selected reference Markdown files are local.

sources.name: Anatomy — Crafted Technical Figures

runtime.three_d_mode: beta; not a general PBR renderer

notes: Excellent for detailed technical machines/instruments/equipment, not a charting library and not a people/character generator.
Core output is SVG with layered WebGL effects; true 3D turning groups are beta and not general purpose PBR.
Run local audits and screenshot checks before delivery; Chrome/Chromium needed for checks.
Optional community publishing is never automatic; no publish command without user request.
MIT; keep upstream copyright/license notice.
TS Brain uses a first-party routing adapter at external/design-library/anatomy/SKILL.md; full upstream Skill, kit and examples remain available under upstream/anatomy/.

O skill descreve a política de decisão; o runtime local renderiza HTML/SVG e só executa VLM quando houver opt-in explícito.
